source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            grid[ny][nx] == color and (ny, nx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            normalized = [(y - top, x - left, color) for y, x in cells]
            height = max(y for y, x in cells) - top + 1
            width = max(x for y, x in cells) - left + 1
            objects.append((left, normalized, height, width))
    objects.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    oy = ox = 0
    for i, (left, cells, height, width) in enumerate(objects):
        if i:
            oy += prev_height - 1
            ox += prev_width - 1
        for y, x, color in cells:
            out[oy + y][ox + x] = color
        prev_height, prev_width = height, width
    return out
'''
